theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_uce_normalized_quot_eq_iff
theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R], let U := {v : R × R // ∃ x y : R, x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1}; let rel : U → U → Prop := fun v w => ∃ u : Rˣ, (u : R) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : R) * v.1.2 = w.1.2; ∀ v w : U, (v.1.1 = 1 ∨ (¬ IsUnit v.1.1 ∧ v.1.2 = 1)) → (w.1.1 = 1 ∨ (¬ IsUnit w.1.1 ∧ w.1.2 = 1)) → (Quot.mk rel v = Quot.mk rel w ↔ v = w)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
